ledger: 00:00–00:01.50 — A, initially the left green '2' block: tabletop → the single visible hand's fingertip grip → leftmost tabletop position. Its exposed body becomes blue by 00:00.75; a second block B separates from its right side around 00:01.00–00:01.25.

00:01.00–00:02.00 — B, blue '3' block: first becomes separately visible beside A under the same grip → hand moves it right → second tabletop position, released by 00:02.00. Its earlier separate custody is not visible.
00:00–00:02.25 — C, original right green '2' block: remains upright on the tabletop while A and B are handled.
00:02.25–00:03.25 — C: tabletop → fingertip grip and rotation → third tabletop position. Another green block D emerges at its right while C remains behind.
00:03.00–00:04.00 — D: first appears beside C in the hand, showing green '3' → remains in the grip while becoming yellow/tan '2' at 00:03.75 → fourth tabletop position at 00:04.00.
00:04.00–00:04.75 — E, pale-blue '3' block: appears extending from D's right side under the fingers → hand moves it right → fifth tabletop position.
00:05.00–00:06.00 — F: another blue '3' block appears beside E in the hand → moves right and becomes green by 00:05.75 → sixth tabletop position showing '5' at 00:06.00.
00:06.00–00:06.75 — G: another blue/green '3' block emerges beside F in the hand → moves right → seventh tabletop position, green and showing '2' by 00:06.75.
00:06.75–00:08.00 — H, blue block: appears in the grip to G's right showing '3' → remains held and turns → eighth tabletop position showing '6', released by 00:08.00.
00:03.25–00:08.00 — Previously placed blocks remain in their respective row positions as the hand adds blocks to the right.
00:08.25–00:08.75 — Hand touches and aligns the central green C and yellow D blocks; both remain on the tabletop.
00:09.00–00:09.75 — Hand grips/nudges the leftmost blue pair A and B together; all eight blocks remain visible on the tabletop.
Throughout — Circular top studs remain associated with their blocks; no separate stud transfer, container use, or hand-to-hand transfer is visible. Audio is unassessed.

findings.entity: Initial left green block A and emerging blue block B
findings.description: At 00:00.50 the held object is a single green-fronted '2' block. Its exposed body becomes blue by 00:00.75, then its right side extends into a separately studded blue '3' block by 00:01.25. A remains on the table while the hand carries B away. The visible body changes and separates without an incoming replacement or a separately supplied second block; this is more than a finger-obscured transfer.

findings.entity: Original right green block C and additional green block D
findings.description: Between 00:02.75 and 00:03.25, the one green block held to the right of the blue pair becomes two full blocks: a green '2' is left standing in position three while a green '3' continues right in the same grip. The additional body emerges from the held block's side, with no separate arrival or release from a concealed palm visible.

findings.entity: Held green block D, resulting yellow block D, and pale-blue block E
findings.description: The exposed green '3' held at 00:03.50 becomes a yellow/tan '2' at 00:03.75. By 00:04.00 that yellow block stands on the table while a blue body extends from its right; at 00:04.25 the hand holds a separate pale-blue '3'. The continuous grip produces a changed block and an additional full block without a visible source or exchange.

findings.entity: Pale-blue block E and additional block F
findings.description: At 00:04.75 the hand is over the single pale-blue '3' at the row's end. At 00:05.00 another blue block extends from its right side, becoming a separate held '3' by 00:05.25 while the original remains in position five. No second block approaches from elsewhere; its body appears during separation from the first.

findings.entity: Held block F and additional block G
findings.description: The blue '3' held at 00:05.25 changes to green through 00:05.50–00:05.75. At 00:06.00 a green '5' remains on the table while another blue/green '3' extends from its right and moves away in the hand by 00:06.25. The exposed object changes appearance and yields an additional block without a supplied source.

findings.entity: Held block G and final blue block H
findings.description: At 00:06.50 the hand holds one greenish '3' beside the six placed blocks. By 00:06.75 a green '2' stands in position seven and a separate blue '3' occupies the continuing grip to its right. The extra block emerges during the held object's separation rather than arriving along a visible custody path.
